summary: American Clean Resources Group (ACRG) filed an 8-K disclosing that it is restructuring a previously announced acquisition of 80.1% of Sustainable Metal Solutions (SMS) into a direct acquisition of the Cross-Caribou mining asset from SMS subsidiary Grand Island Resources. The 2022 agreement has been superseded, but no definitive agreement has been signed for the 2026 Asset Acquisition. Terms such as price, premium, and closing date are not disclosed. The restructuring is subject to definitive documentation, fairness opinion, and regulatory approvals. There is no guarantee the transaction will be completed. Watch for negotiation updates and definitive agreement filings.
